dialogues.jp: 放課後──。
dialogues.en: After school--.
dialogues.text: After school--.

dialogues.jp: 何の気なしに体育館裏へとやって来た。
dialogues.en:
Once again with worries on my mind, I headed for the back of
the gym.
dialogues.text:
Once again with worries on my mind, I headed for the back of
the gym.

dialogues.jp:
期末試験が終わり、あとは卒業式を残すのみと
なった今、どうせ家に帰っても、これと言って
やることはない。
dialogues.en:
With tests over, and school essentially over as well
excepting the graduation party, I still didn't feel like
just going home.
dialogues.text:
With tests over, and school essentially over as well
excepting the graduation party, I still didn't feel like
just going home.

dialogues.jp:
たまにはゲーセンで気晴らしでも、と杉並を誘
おうとしたが、奴は奴で忙しそうだったから、
やめた。
dialogues.en:
I'd asked Suginami whether he wanted to go to the arcades,
but he seemed busy and refused.
dialogues.text:
I'd asked Suginami whether he wanted to go to the arcades,
but he seemed busy and refused.

dialogues.jp:
何やら卒業式に向けて悪事を画策しているらし
く、風紀委員と立ち回りするだけで手がいっぱ
いらしい。
dialogues.en:
He's probably planning some devious scheme just in time for
the graduation period. The discplinary committee'd be on his
case...
dialogues.text:
He's probably planning some devious scheme just in time for
the graduation period. The discplinary committee'd be on his
case...

dialogues.jp:
（毎度のことながら、何を考えて生きているん
　だろうな、あいつは）
dialogues.en:
"(He thinks up of escape routes just as much as of his evil
plots.)"
dialogues.text:
"(He thinks up of escape routes just as much as of his evil
plots.)"

dialogues.jp:
まあ、こんな体育館裏にふらふらと立ち寄る俺
も、あまり人のことは言えないけど。
dialogues.en:
Well, looking at me stopping by behidn this gym rear, I'd
probably look just as suspicious as he does.
dialogues.text:
Well, looking at me stopping by behidn this gym rear, I'd
probably look just as suspicious as he does.

dialogues.jp:
体育館の角をひょいと曲がると、そこにはひっ
そりと｛たたず／佇｝む人影がひとつ。
dialogues.en:
Rounding the corner to the usual place, I saw just one
shadow.
dialogues.text:
Rounding the corner to the usual place, I saw just one
shadow.

dialogues.jp: 予想通り、月城の後ろ姿があった。
dialogues.en: Unsurpisingly, it was the figure of Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text: Unsurpisingly, it was the figure of Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp:
人形を膝の所に抱きかかえたまま、隅に植えら
れている小さな草を見守っている。
dialogues.en:
The doll on her lap, watching over the plant as devotedly as
ever.
dialogues.text:
The doll on her lap, watching over the plant as devotedly as
ever.

dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro..."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro..."

dialogues.jp:
後ろから声をかけると、小さな身体がビクンと
震えたあと、ゆっくりこちらに振り返った。
dialogues.en:
Calling out to her from behind, her body tensed up, as her
head slowly turned to face me.
dialogues.text:
Calling out to her from behind, her body tensed up, as her
head slowly turned to face me.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「悪い。驚かすつもりはなかったんだけど……」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, I didn't mean to scare you..."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I didn't mean to scare you..."

dialogues.jp: 月城が静かに頷いた。
dialogues.en: She sliently nodded.
dialogues.text: She sliently nodded.

dialogues.jp:
ほとんど感情の起伏がない分、白い肌と端正な
顔のつくりが際立っている。
dialogues.en:
She barely showed any emotions, and her skin was pale white,
and prominent.
dialogues.text:
She barely showed any emotions, and her skin was pale white,
and prominent.

dialogues.jp:
髪の色といい、小柄で｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝な体つきといい、一
見すると本当のお人形さんのように見える。
dialogues.en:
Her hair colour, her tiny yet delicate body, all gave her
the image of a marionette.
dialogues.text:
Her hair colour, her tiny yet delicate body, all gave her
the image of a marionette.

dialogues.jp: 「調子はどうだ？」
dialogues.en: "How's it doing?"
dialogues.text: "How's it doing?"

dialogues.jp: 月城が、手袋を外し、人形を触る。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro took off her gloves, and stroked her doll once
more.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro took off her gloves, and stroked her doll once
more.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「いつもと変わらないよ」
dialogues.en: "No different from before."
dialogues.text: "No different from before."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「そっか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.jp:
あそこまで手塩にかけて育てているんだから、
ぜひうまく育ってほしいと俺は思っていた。
dialogues.en:
Even if all it grew was salt, I was hoping it at least grew
SOMETHING.
dialogues.text:
Even if all it grew was salt, I was hoping it at least grew
SOMETHING.

dialogues.jp: ふと、月城の瞳が俺の後ろを見るように動いた。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, Tsukishiro's eyes turned to look at movement
behind me.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, Tsukishiro's eyes turned to look at movement
behind me.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Who is it?"
dialogues.text: "...Who is it?"

dialogues.jp: 月城の視線に気づいて、俺も振り返る。
dialogues.en: Noticing Tsukishiro's stare, I turned around myself.
dialogues.text: Noticing Tsukishiro's stare, I turned around myself.

dialogues.jp:
体育館の陰から、眼鏡をかけた女の子が出てき
た。ななこだった。
dialogues.en:
Standing under the shade of the gym, was a bespectacled
girl. It's Nanako.
dialogues.text:
Standing under the shade of the gym, was a bespectacled
girl. It's Nanako.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの……ご、ごめんなさい……」
dialogues.en: "U, uhm... I'm really sorry..."
dialogues.text: "U, uhm... I'm really sorry..."

dialogues.jp: ななこが、おずおずと進み出た。
dialogues.en: Nanako timidly stepped forward.
dialogues.text: Nanako timidly stepped forward.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「お邪魔するつもりはなかったんです。ただ、
　朝倉くんの後ろ姿を見かけたから、こんな所
　で何してるのかな、と思って……」
dialogues.en:
"I didn't mean to intrude. I just saw Asakura-kun heading
this way, and wondered what he was up to..."
dialogues.text:
"I didn't mean to intrude. I just saw Asakura-kun heading
this way, and wondered what he was up to..."

dialogues.jp:
まるで、殺人現場を目撃した一般人のような、
発言だな……。
dialogues.en: She sounds like she's trying to identify a murder scene...
dialogues.text: She sounds like she's trying to identify a murder scene...

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「先輩のお友達？」
dialogues.en: "A friend of yours, Senpai?"
dialogues.text: "A friend of yours, Senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「そんなところだ」
dialogues.en: "Indeed."
dialogues.text: "Indeed."

dialogues.jp:
俺は簡単にななこを紹介した。と言っても名前
と学年とクラスを教えただけなんだけど。
dialogues.en:
I gave a simple and quick introduction; just her name and
her class.
dialogues.text:
I gave a simple and quick introduction; just her name and
her class.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「どうも、彩珠ななこです」
dialogues.en: "Hello, my name is Saitama Nanako."
dialogues.text: "Hello, my name is Saitama Nanako."

dialogues.jp: ななこが、月城に向かってぺこりと頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: Nanako bowed politely in front of Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text: Nanako bowed politely in front of Tsukishiro.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「ボクはピロス。こっちは……」
dialogues.en: "I'm Piros. And this is..."
dialogues.text: "I'm Piros. And this is..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「月城アリスさんですよね」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro Alice-san, right?"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro Alice-san, right?"

dialogues.jp: 月城が名乗るより先に、ななこが言った。
dialogues.en: Before her name could be mentioned, Nanako said it.
dialogues.text: Before her name could be mentioned, Nanako said it.

dialogues.jp: 「あれっ、知り合い？」
dialogues.en: "Huh, you know her?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, you know her?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「いえ。話をするのは初めてですけど、以前、
　校内で見かけた時に、人形を抱いていたから
　印象に残っていたんです……」
dialogues.en:
"No, it's the first time we've talked. There's only one
person in this school who carries a doll around with her
though..."
dialogues.text:
"No, it's the first time we've talked. There's only one
person in this school who carries a doll around with her
though..."

dialogues.jp:
言って、ななこがカバンからメモ帳を取り出し、
パラパラとめくった。
dialogues.en:
As she talked, she suddenly reached into her bag and took
out her notepad, and started scribbling furiously.
dialogues.text:
As she talked, she suddenly reached into her bag and took
out her notepad, and started scribbling furiously.

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、その日のこともちゃんと、メモして
いたらしい。
dialogues.en:
Seems like just like that day, she has a lot to take note
of...
dialogues.text:
Seems like just like that day, she has a lot to take note
of...

dialogues.jp: うーむ、マメと言うか、好奇心旺盛と言うか。
dialogues.en:
Well, if you could call it something to take note of; maybe
it's just plain curiosity.
dialogues.text:
Well, if you could call it something to take note of; maybe
it's just plain curiosity.

dialogues.jp:
ななこは、ピロスに話しかけられても平気なよ
うだった。
dialogues.en:
Nanako was talking happily with Piros without a care in the
world.
dialogues.text:
Nanako was talking happily with Piros without a care in the
world.

dialogues.jp:
少しくらい不思議がれ、と言いたいところだが、
まあ、ななこだからなぁ……。
dialogues.en:
You would imagine that it's a bit strange, but, well, it's
Nanako after all...
dialogues.text:
You would imagine that it's a bit strange, but, well, it's
Nanako after all...

dialogues.jp:
ごく普通の自然体で接しているななこに、月城
もわずかだけど緊張感を解いたようだった。
dialogues.en:
At Nanako's relative outgoingness and forwardness though,
the tension on Tsukishiro's face was clear to see.
dialogues.text:
At Nanako's relative outgoingness and forwardness though,
the tension on Tsukishiro's face was clear to see.

dialogues.jp:
ひと言、ふた言、挨拶を交したあと、月城が小
さな口を開いた。
dialogues.en:
After just a couple of words and a greeting, she never
opened her mouth again, until,
dialogues.text:
After just a couple of words and a greeting, she never
opened her mouth again, until,

dialogues.jp:
言いにくそうな月城の代わりに、人形が語を継
いだ。
dialogues.en: Speaking for Tsukishiro, Piros continued on.
dialogues.text: Speaking for Tsukishiro, Piros continued on.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「彩珠先輩と、朝倉先輩って、どういう仲なの」
dialogues.en: "Saitama-senpai and Asakura-senpai seem close."
dialogues.text: "Saitama-senpai and Asakura-senpai seem close."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "Ehhh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehhh?"

dialogues.jp: 俺も同時に、ぎょっと息を飲んでいた。
dialogues.en: Like Nanako, I took a startled breath at the same time.
dialogues.text: Like Nanako, I took a startled breath at the same time.

dialogues.jp:
意表を突かれたななこが、助けを求めるように
俺のほうを見る。
dialogues.en:
The surprised Nanako looked at me. Seems like I have to
explain...
dialogues.text:
The surprised Nanako looked at me. Seems like I have to
explain...

dialogues.jp: 「べ、別にただの友達だよ……」
dialogues.en: "W, we're just normal friends..."
dialogues.text: "W, we're just normal friends..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうですよ、ねえ」
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah, that's all."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah, that's all."

dialogues.jp:
お互いにぎこちない笑みを浮かべて、何となく
否定しあう。
dialogues.en: Nanako followed up on me, with a nervous laugh.
dialogues.text: Nanako followed up on me, with a nervous laugh.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「そっか。ごめんなさい。仲が良さそうだから、
　もしかして、おつき合いしてるのかと思って」
dialogues.en:
"I see, I'm sorry. You seemed close, so we maybe thought you
were dating."
dialogues.text:
"I see, I'm sorry. You seemed close, so we maybe thought you
were dating."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、かすかに頭を下げると、また草のほう
にもどっていった。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro had her head bowed, still watching over the
plant.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro had her head bowed, still watching over the
plant.

dialogues.jp: 残された俺とななこが、再び顔を見合わせる。
dialogues.en:
With just Nanako and myself left, we turned to look at each
other.
dialogues.text:
With just Nanako and myself left, we turned to look at each
other.

dialogues.jp: 「え、えーと……」
dialogues.en: "Eh, umm..."
dialogues.text: "Eh, umm..."

dialogues.jp:
何をどうやって、話を切り出していいか、わか
らず、俺が頭を｛か／掻｝く。
dialogues.en:
What to say, what to do, my head was swimming with millions
of things to think of.
dialogues.text:
What to say, what to do, my head was swimming with millions
of things to think of.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「あ、あの……あたし、これから用事があるん
　で、先に失礼しますね」
dialogues.en: "U, uhm... I have stuff to do, so I'd be going now!"
dialogues.text: "U, uhm... I have stuff to do, so I'd be going now!"

dialogues.jp:
なぜか、顔を真っ赤にしながら、ななこは俺と
月城に軽く手を振り、そそくさと去っていった。
dialogues.en:
With her face bright red, Nanako gave Tsukishiro and myself
a wave, then left quickly.
dialogues.text:
With her face bright red, Nanako gave Tsukishiro and myself
a wave, then left quickly.

dialogues.jp:
ぽつねんと立って、ななこの後ろ姿を見送って
いた俺は、小首を傾げた。
dialogues.en:
Looking at her steadily departing figure, my head tilted to
the side in thought.
dialogues.text:
Looking at her steadily departing figure, my head tilted to
the side in thought.

dialogues.jp: 「……よくわからん」
dialogues.en: "...I don't understand her."
dialogues.text: "...I don't understand her."

dialogues.jp:
そもそも、月城の質問の意図は何だったんだろ
うか。
dialogues.en: And also, what was Tsukishiro trying to say...
dialogues.text: And also, what was Tsukishiro trying to say...

dialogues.jp:
見ると、月城はいつものように草の前にちょこ
んと座っている。
dialogues.en:
The girl herself though, was as usual, squatting in front of
the plant.
dialogues.text:
The girl herself though, was as usual, squatting in front of
the plant.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、月城……」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tsukishiro..."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tsukishiro..."

dialogues.jp: 俺が声をかけると、月城がわすがに振り向いた。
dialogues.en: Upon hearing my voice, her head turned around to face me.
dialogues.text: Upon hearing my voice, her head turned around to face me.

dialogues.jp: （あれっ？）

いつもは、ほとんど感情を表さない月城の唇に
どこか嬉しそうな小さな笑みが浮かんでいるこ
とに気づいた。
dialogues.en:
Instead of the expressionless face I was accustomed to
seeing, Tsukishiro had a small, happy smile on her lips
instead.
dialogues.text:
Instead of the expressionless face I was accustomed to
seeing, Tsukishiro had a small, happy smile on her lips
instead.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「あ、いや。なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "Ah, um, it's nothing."
dialogues.text: "Ah, um, it's nothing."

dialogues.jp:
俺はなぜか照れ隠しのように、天を仰いでいた。
青い空を白い雲が駆けていく。
dialogues.en:
Feeling embarassed for some reason, I tilted my head up to
look at the big blue sky, and the white clouds floating
around.
dialogues.text:
Feeling embarassed for some reason, I tilted my head up to
look at the big blue sky, and the white clouds floating
around.

dialogues.jp: （ま、いっか……）
dialogues.en: "(Well, whatever...)"
dialogues.text: "(Well, whatever...)"

dialogues.jp:
春の訪れを告げる心地よい風が、体育館裏に吹
いていた。
dialogues.en:
The wind started blowing through the rear of the gym,
showing the first signs of spring.
dialogues.text:
The wind started blowing through the rear of the gym,
showing the first signs of spring.

dialogues.jp: ◆ふたりの関係◆
dialogues.en: ◆Our Connection◆
dialogues.text: ◆Our Connection◆

dialogues.jp:
体育館裏で月城といつものように話していると、
ななこが現われた。
dialogues.en:
While talking with Alice behind the gym as usual, Nanako
showed up.
dialogues.text:
While talking with Alice behind the gym as usual, Nanako
showed up.

dialogues.jp:
ピロスに二人はどういう関係なのかと尋ねられ、
動揺してしまう俺達だった。
dialogues.en:
Piros asked us what kind of relationship we had, which
provided all sorts of disturbance among us.
dialogues.text:
Piros asked us what kind of relationship we had, which
provided all sorts of disturbance among us.
